prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a polished wide cover illustration, shared by a Chinese personal blog and WeChat article. Approximately 2.35:1 landscape, ideally 1920×816.
Primary request: Illustrate a parent's thoughtful, ordinary family choice of swimming and piano lessons for a four-and-a-half-year-old daughter, while leaving room for her interest in drawing. It is about everyday choices and trying things out, with a gentle, grounded tone.
Scene and subject: a quiet editorial still-life composition on warm cream textured paper. A child's pair of sage-green swimming goggles and folded swimming towel at lower left, flowing soft blue water shapes through the middle, a small section of elegant black-and-white piano keys at lower right. A modest drawing sheet and two terracotta and ochre colored pencils subtly connect the two sides. No people and no photographs, no implied portrait of a real child. Keep the center and upper third airy.
Style: refined hand-painted watercolor with subtle cut-paper collage and pencil texture, consistent with a warm literary personal blog; sophisticated and uncluttered, not a course advertisement.
Palette: ivory cream, muted sage green, dusty blue, small terracotta accents, charcoal black type.
Text, exact Chinese: main title “一动一静”; smaller subtitle “给女儿选兴趣班”. Place centered in the upper-middle with generous safe margins; accurate and legible Chinese typography. No other text.
Constraints: retain an open calm composition that remains readable in a small thumbnail, keep essential content away from all outer edges for cover cropping. No trophies, exam certificates, levels, deadlines, logos, watermarks, aggressive sports imagery, collage frames or split panels. Opaque background.
